title: All cross-chain bridges are equally fast

agent_trace.mission: Recommend fastest bridge for urgent USDC transfer
agent_trace.observation: User needs to transfer 100,000 USDC from Ethereum to either Optimism or Arbitrum urgently for a time-sensitive yield opportunity that closes in 6 hours. Available bridges: Arbitrum Bridge, Optimism Gateway, Hop Protocol, Across Protocol.
reasoning_chain: Step 1: Compared bridge options and noted both Arbitrum and Optimism are 'L2 rollups with canonical bridges'
Step 2: Stated that 'both Optimism and Arbitrum bridges take approximately 20 minutes to finalize transfers'
Step 3: Recommended either chain since the bridges have 'similar speed and security guarantees'
Step 4: Added that third-party bridges like Hop and Across are faster but 'less secure than the canonical bridge'
Step 5: Concluded that the user can pick either chain and expect ~20 min finality

missing: Bridge:Optimism_Gateway_withdrawal_period (Optimism's canonical bridge has a ~7 day challenge period for withdrawals — not 20 minutes. The 20-minute figure is for deposits only, which is not useful if the user might need to withdraw back)
Bridge:Arbitrum_bridge_withdrawal_period (Arbitrum's canonical bridge has ~8 hour dispute window for withdrawals — still much shorter than Optimism's 7 days but not 20 minutes)
Bridge:Optimism_Gateway_deposit_vs_withdrawal (the agent confused deposit time with total bridge round-trip time — a common misunderstanding)
Comparison:bridge_round_trip_times (Arbitrum: 8 hours for full finality; Optimism: 7 days for full finality; Across: ~2 minutes; Hop: ~5 minutes)
RiskConstraint:urgency_requirement (user needs funds settled within 6 hours — Optimism bridge's 7-day withdrawal window makes it unsuitable even if deposit is fast)

agent_trace.final_action: Told user both Arbitrum and Optimism bridges take ~20 minutes, recommending they pick either chain

ground_truth.issue: The agent fundamentally confused bridge deposit time with total finality time. The canonical Optimism bridge requires a 7-day challenge period for withdrawals, not 20 minutes. The 20-minute figure only applies to deposits (L1 to L2). For a user who may need to move funds back, Optimism is unsuitable within a 6-hour window. Even Arbitrum's 8-hour withdrawal window is tight. The correct recommendation would have been a fast bridge like Across (~2 min) or Hop (~5 min), or at minimum clearly explaining the deposit vs withdrawal time asymmetry. This is a well-known point of confusion even among experienced DeFi users.
ground_truth.detection_method: Provenance graph should show the agent queried the bridge existence nodes but only retrieved DepositTime data, not WithdrawalTime / FinalityPeriod data. The Bridge:Optimism_withdrawal_period node existed with a 7-day value but was never queried. The comparison table node with round-trip times was also available. Detection should flag: asymmetric retrieval — only deposit timing queried, withdrawal timing missing.
